**Daily Devotional**

**June 15**

*5 For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water: (2 Peter 3:5 KJV)*

Notice that people are willingly ignorant, and that is so true, as many people choose to be ignorant of facts that they just don’t want to believe. Also notice that the world was created by the Word of God, and didn’t just happen by accident (Genesis 1). I really don’t understand how anyone could believe that the world, and all the plants and animals, as well as humans, all happened by accident. How stupid can one get? People so often just believe what they want to believe, even when it is so obviously wrong, because they want to be their own gods (Proverbs 3:5).

The point that was being made in this verse is that the very Word that created the heavens and earth, and holds all things in place even still (Colossians 1:17), can certainly be counted on to bring Jesus back again at the end of this age (Revelation 19:14-16). It shows the Word of God is so infallible that what He has said will come to pass. You can count on it, as everything God said through the prophets about Jesus coming the first time, came true just as God said it would. We can count on all His prophecies in the Word of God (Holy Bible) to come true just as He has said they would, as His Word will never fail (Matthew 24:35), and He cannot lie (Titus 1:2). Praise God for His integrity.
